status: Core difficulty selection and encounter resets delivered in Prototype 58 / 0.58.0; Hard selection portraits integrated; gameplay costumes pending.
user_request: Difficulty selection screen and full encounter respawn from active respawn origin; consult Art, Engineering, Storyboarding.

flow.recommended: Start Game -> Hero -> Difficulty -> existing introduction/play
flow.back: Return to hero selection preserving choice
flow.input: Existing keyboard/controller/mouse conventions; A confirms/B backs; release guards prevent instant start

difficulty.easy: Fixed authored roster and approved entrances, consistent progress-relative timing; smaller groups and longer breathing.
difficulty.normal: Controlled seeded variants of entrances, timing and compatible species; baseline intended challenge.
difficulty.hard: Broader tested combinations and overlap, shorter recovery; preserve safe exits and readable warnings.
difficulty.shared: Initially preserve hero stats, weapon damage, monster HP, attack behavior; challenge via encounter scheduling.
difficulty.safety: Static still respects safe entry. No under-hero emergence or offscreen aimed fire. Never dump deferred backlog or silently raise bullet/pattern caps.
difficulty.retry: Resolve arrangement for run, retain on death/retry from checkpoint; new full run can select new seed.
difficulty.tuning: Exact variant weights/counts/timings are implementation tuning requiring tests, not approved numeric balance.

respawn.supersedes: Historical preservation of defeated monsters and live encounter progress across player death.
respawn.before_checkpoint: Reset all level encounters from beginning, including defeated enemies.
respawn.after_checkpoint: Reset encounters belonging to active checkpoint segment and ahead; completed earlier sections remain inactive and cannot send pursuers.
respawn.boundary: Partition checkpoint-straddling waves by explicit encounter ownership/eligible position, not current enemy position. No duplicate or skipped reset entries.
respawn.clear: Old enemies/corpses, player and hostile projectiles, warning reservations, attack tokens, retry timers and local progression counters must be reset consistently.
respawn.retain: Selected hero/difficulty/run arrangement; decrement life once, preserve active checkpoint and single-clone stock. No extra lives, clone refill or full intro on death.
respawn.source_finding: Historical pre-fix finding: preserving_respawn suppressed encounter reset. Prototype 58 reconstructs eligible encounters by stable origin ownership; earlier segment remains excluded.
respawn.optional_checkpoint_tail: 4700 entry expires at4800; intentional optional bypass during1.25s active-control grace. Eligible restoration does not guarantee issuance.

art.required: Difficulty subscreen assets as needed after Engineering dimensions/runtime contract, reuse existing approved art where suitable.
art.constraints: No runtime collider/stat changes for cosmetics; preserve readable held tools and hero identity. No independent Engineering art substitutes.
art.approved_direction: Hard-mode Tony and Sean have exaggerated muscles and torn work clothes, retaining trousers and recognizable trade gear.
art.approval: Sean explicitly chose this direction on October 17, 2026 and requested production.
art.status: Hard selection busts integrated in Prototype 58; full gameplay body/aim/death/HUD/dispenser costume artwork remains in production.
art.delivery_scope: Selection-only costume milestone; current gameplay sprites remain unchanged. Full runtime appearance must not be claimed complete.

owners.engineering: Implementation, coordination with Level Design, runtime data, tests, roadmap, build/version/signing, storybook capture or honest backlog.
owners.art: Menu art and visual recommendations, source metadata/prompts.
owners.storyboarding: Natural concise mode copy and creative opinion; no shame for Easy players; storybook editorial.

acceptance: All three modes differ as described; labels never promise unimplemented dynamic scheduling.
Both heroes: pre-checkpoint death restores defeated encounter enemies; checkpoint death restores segment/ahead without old-section pursuers.
Kill, damage, warn, fire, die: restored full enemy HP and clean budgets/projectiles/corpses; no duplicate life loss.
Same run seed/arrangement across retry; new run variations reproducible for testing.
Checkpoint boundary crossing and straddling wave reset are explicit; no old ambush immediately on protected respawn.
Single clone remains consumed after actual vend across deaths, new run refills.
Menu Back/confirm and held input do not skip screen; selection survives navigation and reaches runtime.
Headless checks and packaged export required; visual/audio/fairness review remains separately pending.
delivery: Engineering reports exported/signed Prototype 58,11 Python tests and13 packaged suites passing. Review findings for actual crowd limits and natural death-flush completion fixed and regressed. No foreground launch or actual screenshots; human visual/audio/fairness review pending.
verification_attribution: Delivery evidence read from Engineering handoff; tests were not independently rerun by Mechanics. Invulnerable scripted traversal is not survival/fairness proof.
